text.title: Spring Boot Patterns Worked Example
text.summary: End-to-end worked example: a layered OrderController + OrderService + OrderRepository slice that satisfies every rule in 01-core-rules.xml, including validation at the boundary and actuator exposure.

section.title: Worked example — POST /orders on a Boot 3.4 monolith

example.note: Context: existing `Order` `@Entity` with `@OneToMany(LineItem)` LAZY. The endpoint must validate the payload, persist, and return a DTO — no entity crosses the controller boundary.
Step 1 — the `Order` entity already exists with lazy associations; the schema change ships as a Flyway migration in the same PR.

Step 2 — `OrderRepository extends JpaRepository<Order, UUID>` with `@EntityGraph(attributePaths = "items")` on `findById`, so the association the DTO needs is loaded inside the transaction rather than lazily at serialisation time.

Step 3 — `OrderService.create(OrderRequest)` is `@Transactional`: it maps request → entity, calls `repository.save`, and maps entity → `OrderResponse` while the session is still open, per `dto-record-separate-from-entity` and `transactional-on-service`.

Step 4 — `record OrderRequest(@NotBlank String customer, @NotEmpty @Valid List<LineItemRequest> items)`. The nested list carries its own `@Valid` so line-item constraints are enforced too, per `validation-on-controller`.

Step 5 — `OrderController` is constructor-injected and exposes `@PostMapping ResponseEntity<OrderResponse> create(@Valid @RequestBody OrderRequest req)`. No `@Transactional`, no `try/catch`: the `@RestControllerAdvice` turns `MethodArgumentNotValidException` into a `ProblemDetail` 400.
Step 6 — `management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,prometheus`, secured with Spring Security, per `actuator-health-required`. A `@WebMvcTest` asserts 400 when `customer` is missing.

Result: the endpoint returns 201 with a `Location` header; the transaction is scoped to `service.create`; lazy associations resolve inside it via `@EntityGraph`; and `http.server.requests` appears on the Prometheus scrape.
